response.answer: NIDECKER THE GUN 2027 — Comprehensive Product Fact Sheet BRAND & MANUFACTURER 1. Brand: Nidecker [1] 2. Manufacturer: Nidecker SA, 2 place de l'Industrie, 1180 Rolle, Switzerland [2] 3. Company founded: 1887 in Etoy, Switzerland, by Henri Nidecker I [3] 4. Nidecker is 100% family-owned, now in fifth generation [4] 5. First snowboard produced: 1984 in Rolle, Switzerland [5] 6. Nidecker is the oldest European snowboard brand still in operation [6] 7. Parent group: Nidecker Group (brands include Bataleon, Jones, Rome, ThirtyTwo, etnies, éS, Emerica) [7] 8. Nidecker Group CEO: Henry Nidecker [8] 9. Sustainability: 1% of every sale goes to environmental initiatives [9] 10. Headquarters: Rolle, Switzerland, near Lake Geneva [10] MODEL IDENTIFICATION 11. Model name: The Gun [1] 12. Model year: 2027 (merchant verified) [11] 13. Product type: Snowboard [1] 14. Board category: Freeride-Powder (merchant verified) [11] 15. Model series: Part of Nidecker's Snow Surf Quiver series (alongside The Smoke and Mosquito) [12] 16. Design inspiration: Classic "gun"-shaped surfboards used for big waves [13] 17. Designer/shaper: Thierry Kunz ("Shape by TK") [14] 18. Pro model rider: Mike Basich — "the go-to choice of legendary bomb dropper Mike Basich" [15] 19. Mike Basich is a snowboard legend who has been pushing boundaries since the 1980s [16] 20. Original Gun model first released by Nidecker in 1987 — "was widely received as looking a good 20 years ahead of its time" [17] 21. The modern Gun (Snow Surf Quiver) has been in the lineup since approximately 2017/2018 season [18] 22. The Gun is the longest and fastest board in Nidecker's Snow Surf Quiver [19] PRICING & AVAILABILITY 23. MSRP (Nidecker direct, USD): $689.95 [20] 24. Sale price at evo.com (USD): $482.96 (30% off) [21] 25. Sale price at SpokeX (USD): $538.16 (regular $689.95) [22] 26. Price at Snowinn/Tradeinn (USD): $572.99 [23] 27. AUD price at Melbourne Snowboard Centre: $1,099.99 (merchant verified preorder) [11] 28. Melbourne Snowboard Centre estimated availability: May 1, 2026 (merchant verified) [11] 29. Order status at Melbourne Snowboard Centre: PREORDER (merchant verified) [11] 30. evo.com stock status: In stock [24] 31. Nidecker direct: Free shipping (5–8 days) in US for orders over $100 [25] RETAILERS & SUPPLIERS 32. Supplier: Nidecker.com (manufacturer direct) — high reputation, official [20] 33. Supplier: evo.com (major US outdoor retailer) — high reputation, lowest price guarantee [21] 34. Supplier: SpokeX — small retailer, on-sale price available [22] 35. Supplier: Snowinn/Tradeinn (European online retailer) — large catalog, marketplace model [23] 36. Supplier: Melbourne Snowboard Centre (Australian retailer) — established specialty shop [11] 37. Supplier: Snow Central (Australian retailer) [26] 38. Supplier: Boardsports.eu / Brettsport (German retailer) [27] 39. Supplier: boards-sports.com (Polish retailer) [2] 40. Supplier: GetBoards (specialty retailer) — listed 2024 model year version [28] KEY SPECIFICATIONS (174cm) 41. Overall length: 174cm / 1740mm [29] 42. Available sizes: 174cm only (single size) (merchant verified) [11] 43. Effective edge length: 1270mm / 127.0cm (merchant verified, confirmed by Snowinn specs) [29] 44. Contact edge length: 1080mm [29] 45. Nose length: 530mm [29] 46. Tail length: 130mm [29] 47. Sidecut radius: 10.0m (merchant verified, confirmed across multiple sources) [29][30] 48. Sidecut description: "R10 — the longest in Nidecker's line, designed for heavier riders and anyone who wants drawn out, horizontal carves" [30] 49. DISAGREEMENT — Sidecut type: Merchant site states sidecut 10.0m (single radius). A forum user reports the Gun has a multi-radius sidecut of "20-10-15.5 m" [31]. Comment: The official spec gives 10m as the primary sidecut radius; the forum user may be describing a progressive/compound sidecut measured differently. Take the manufacturer number as primary. 50. Nose width: 298mm / 29.8cm [29] vs 29.0cm (merchant verified) [11]. DISAGREEMENT: Snowinn lists nose width as 298mm; merchant data lists 29.0cm. The Snowinn spec sheet appears to refer to a different model year's measurement, so both are included. 51. Tail width: 290mm / 29.0cm [29] vs 28.2cm (merchant verified) [11]. DISAGREEMENT: Same source discrepancy as nose width. Merchant data and Snowinn data differ, likely reflecting slight year-over-year changes. 52. Waist width: 257mm / 25.7cm (merchant verified, confirmed by Snowinn) [29][11] 53. Underfoot width front foot: 264mm [29] 54. Underfoot width rear foot: 263mm [29] 55. Taper: 8mm [29] 56. Setback: 35mm / 3.5cm (merchant verified, confirmed by Snowinn) [29][11] 57. DISAGREEMENT — Reference stance: Merchant data gives 52.0cm [11]. Snowinn specs give 540mm / 54.0cm [29]. Comment: A 2cm difference between merchant and Snowinn data; the Snowinn data is from a detailed spec sheet, while merchant data may reflect 2027 model updates. 58. Min/max stance: 500–620mm [29] 59. Recommended rider weight: 75+ kg / 165+ lbs [29][11] 60. Width category: Standard (merchant verified) [11] 61. Gender: Unisex (merchant verified) [11] SHAPE & PROFILE 62. Shape: Tapered Directional (merchant verified) [11] 63. Shape description: "Long directional shape with oversized nose" [32] 64. Nose design: Oversized/extended nose — "diamond pow nose" for powder float (merchant verified) [33] 65. Tail design: Short, rounded tail for surf-like feel [34] 66. Camber type: Surfy CamRock (merchant verified) [11] 67. Camber description: "Extended rocker at the nose and regular camber through the rest of the board. Together with a shorter tail, it allows you to glide over bumps or pow and initiate turns off the back foot for a unique, surf-like ride" [35] 68. Profile: Rocker/Camber (rocker nose, camber underfoot through tail) [36] CONSTRUCTION & MATERIALS 69. Construction: Power Rails (exclusive Nidecker construction inspired by surfboards) (merchant verified) [37] 70. Construction detail: "The topsheet is wrapped over a rounded wood core to meet a thin sidewall. It's a beautiful finish that delivers instant drive through the edge." [38] 71. Sidewall material: Slim ABS sidewall [39] 72. Sidewall thickness: 2mm sidewall in riding section [40] 73. Sidewall construction: Cap construction for nose and tail; sandwich construction with thin sidewall in riding section [40] 74. Core material: Light Core — Paulownia, Poplar, Beech stringers (merchant verified) [11] 75. Core description: "Nidecker's lightest core — featuring three different wood types. Paulownia for lightness, poplar for pop and responsiveness, and hardwood beech stringers along the edges to increase core durability, pop and protection from edge impacts" [41] 76. Beech stringer location: "down the center" per evo, "along the edges" per GetBoards [42][41]. DISAGREEMENT: evo says "down the center" while other sources say "along the edges." Both are cited. 77. Carbon reinforcement: Pop Carbon Plus — carbon on top and bottom of core, nose to tail (merchant verified) [43] 78. Pop Carbon Plus description: "Deployed on both sides of the core and from tip to tail, beefing up the flex. Ideal for aggressive riders who want snappy edge response, tons of pop and a smooth ride at high speeds." [44] 79. DISAGREEMENT — Carbon placement: 2027 evo listing and Melbourne Snowboard say "nose to tail" for Pop Carbon Plus [43][44]. Older model year (2024 GetBoards) describes Pop Carbon as "strategic placement from tail to rear inserts, and from nose to front inserts" [45]. Comment: The 2027 model appears to use an upgraded version (Pop Carbon Plus vs Pop Carbon) with full nose-to-tail carbon. 80. Fiberglass type: Triax Plus (merchant verified) [11] 81. Fiberglass description: "Woven in three directions at 45° for max stiffness. Uses different glass densities above and below the core for consistent torsional flex, better pop, and lightning response." [46] 82. Earlier model years also used Biax Plus fiberglass in combination with Triax [47] 83. Topsheet: Absorbnid Topsheet (merchant verified) [11] 84. Topsheet description: "Innovative top layer designed to absorb unwanted vibrations. Enjoy a smooth ride with less fatigue." [48] 85. Base material: N-9000 Sintered (merchant verified) [11] 86. Base description: "Lightning quick sintered base made from super dense material with high carbon content to minimize friction" (merchant verified) [11] 87. Base technology: "Produced with carbon nanoparticles, the N-9000 has a very dense molecular structure, which makes it Nidecker's fastest, most durable base option" [49] 88. Nose carbon inlays: "The Gun's extended nose features carbon inlays within the construction to reinforce the flex and smooth the ride" [50] 89. Mounting pattern: 2x4 Inserts (merchant verified) [11] 90. Insert rows: 6 rows of inserts at 2cm intervals [51] 91. Binding compatibility: Works with any binding on the market [51] FLEX & PERFORMANCE 92. Flex rating: 8/10 (merchant verified) [11] 93. Flex category: Stiff (per evo classification) [52] 94. Flex direction: Directional (stiffer tail) [53] 95. Rider level: Advanced (merchant verified) [11] 96. Riding style: Freeride, Powder, Carving (merchant verified) [11] 97. Terrain: Big mountain freeride, steeps, powder, open faces (merchant verified) [11] 98. Use case: Speed, float, powerful carving in steep and deep terrain (merchant verified) [11] 99. Ride characteristics: "Fast, fluid, and confidence-inspiring—especially in open terrain" [54] 100. Stability: "Stability is central to the Gun's design" [55] WARRANTY & POLICIES 101. Warranty: 2-year warranty against manufacturer's defects, extendable to 3 years by registering [56] 102. Nidecker return policy (direct): Return unused items within 30 days for full refund [25] REVIEW OPINIONS & USER EXPERIENCE 103. Whitelines 2021/22 review: "Excels doing huge, fast turns, whether you're on hardpack or off-piste" [57] 104. Whitelines 2021/22 review (target rider): "Powerful riders who aren't afraid of a big snowboard, or going very, very fast. Chances are it will be a second deck for powder days." [58] 105. Whitelines 2020/21 review (positive): "Amazing in powder, the board turns really well and doesn't feel heavy" [59] 106. Whitelines 2020/21 review (positive): Praised as lightweight despite its size — "so lightweight for a board you would predict to be heavy" [60] 107. Whitelines 2020/21 review (negative): "Don't try and go through too many tight trannies, as she's good at getting caught up. I took her in the trees and they got a little too tight." [61] 108. Whitelines 2017/18 review: "Coming in at either 161cm or 171cm, and with a sidecut radius of 9 or 10 metres, this thing is an absolute weapon!" [62] 109. Whitelines 2019/20 review: "This surf-like gun isn't for the mellow cruiser" — not recommended as a versatile all-mountain board [63] 110. Powderstuff review: "It's not a daily driver. It's a quiver killer for big days, deep conditions, and full-send lines." [64] 111. Nidecker website user review: "I have now three days on this board carving the arctic groomers and it feels great… it needs the speed, but once you have it you can really lean in and trust that the edge holds." [65] 112. SnowCountry summary: "A board for speed demons who want to start a carve full throttle and attack the fresh at speed" [66] 113. Forum user (snowboardingforum.com): "The big Gun having a 10m sidecut radius" — noted as producing very wide turns vs more typical carving boards [67] 114. Forum user on sidecut: Reports Gun has multi-radius sidecut "20-10-15.5 m" which "turns considerably wider than my Alchemist" [31] 115. Design aesthetic: "Minimalist and premium. Clean surf-inspired aesthetics with subtle textures and timeless color blocking." [68] 116. Whitelines 2021/22 review on build quality: "Flawless finish" with "stunning matt black and tinted resin topsheet" [69] COMPARABLE PRODUCTS & COMPETITORS 117. Comparable board (per YouTube review): Korua Café Pencil [70] 118. Comparable board (per YouTube review): Lib Tech Steely D [70] 119. Comparable board (per YouTube review): Nitro Quiver Cannon [70] 120. Within Nidecker lineup — The Smoke is a sibling model for drawn-out carving at high speed [71] 121. Within Nidecker lineup — The Mosquito is the small/nimble sibling for tight terrain [72] 122. Competitive landscape: Korua Dart, Korua Pencil, Jones Hovercraft, K2 Simple Pleasures, Lib Tech T.Rice Orca, Stranda boards all compete in the freeride/alt-shape/carving space [73] 123. Forum comparison: Nidecker Beta APX noted as "much more lively and nimble" vs Korua Dart, with "less taper, less setback, more normal sidecut" [74] 124. Carvers Connection forum: Korua boards use "basic (biax wrapped poplar) and don't hold a lot of edge pressure" compared to boards with more advanced construction like Nidecker's [75] HISTORICAL & HERITAGE NOTES 125. The original "Gun" model from 1987 "was one of the first innovative shapes that had similar curves to a modern day snowboard" [76] 126. In 1987, Nidecker manufactured the first snowboard to descend from the top of Mont Blanc [77] 127. The modern Gun was re-introduced as part of Thierry Kunz's Snow Surf Quiver line around 2017/2018 [14] 128. Nidecker pioneered the 4x2 insert pattern, first asymmetrical snowboard (1990), and 'double flex control' (1993) [78] ADDITIONAL TECHNICAL NOTES 129. Construction precision: "Material layers measured in tenths of millimeters" [40] 130. Board rides surf-like: "Initiate turns off the back foot for a unique, surf-like ride" [35] 131. Not suitable for tight trees (based on reviewer experience at 174cm length) [61] 132. Best suited for wide-open terrain, groomers, and powder fields [57] 133. Nidecker's reference stance is "the second narrowest position possible" in the insert range [79] 134. Recommended as a quiver board, not a daily driver / one-board setup [64][58]
